data.title: 塑心 · 露台上的低语
data.description: 她在露台回眸招手，等你走近才说起刚才那段旋律，声音像刻意留给你一个人。
data.action: 倚栏回眸，招手邀请靠近
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Virtuosa leans against the carved stone balustrade of a high balcony at night, looking back over her shoulder and beckoning the viewer closer with a subtle wave. A crystal glass of red wine rests on the parapet beside her against a panoramic backdrop of glittering city lamps.
data.animaCaption: Turning at the edge of the stone balcony, she gestures the viewer toward her with a knowing smile, her voice carrying softly over the night breeze.
